description: Hydrogeofetch is the US Geological Survey's R tool chain for discovering, subsetting and preparing hydrographic data, renamed from nhdplusTools. It focuses on NHDPlus and related United States hydrographic products, using network identifiers, geometry queries and local or web-service inputs. Outputs are selected flowlines, catchments and associated attributes for modelling workflows. Geographic coverage follows the United States source products. Source is free under CC0-1.0, with public documentation and a software DOI. A limitation is that general network navigation, indexing and attribute calculations have moved to the separate hydroloom package; older scripts must follow the documented migration. The repository also identifies the software as preliminary or provisional. Hydrogeofetch can supply river-network inputs for flood, water-supply and infrastructure simulations, related to Wflow (model-wflow). The old and new package names were compared together during duplicate checks. No hydrographic data or package archive was downloaded.
